# Introduction

- **Goal:** Analyze and predict flight departure delays using real-world data
- **Why:** Delays cost time, money, and disrupt travel plans

---

# Data Source & Pipeline

- **API:** Purchased real flight and weather data ($50)
- **Dataset:** 1,709 flights, 7+ features (airline, airports, time, wind, etc.)
- **Pipeline:** Automated fetch, clean, merge, and update (Python + R)
- **Live Data:** Dashboard refreshes with new data with a button

---

# Data Preparation & Cleaning

- **Data wrangling:** 
  - Removed incomplete/duplicate records
  - Engineered features (hour, day of week, wind buckets)
  - Capped extreme outliers for delay at 120 min
- **Integrity checks:** Ensured all predictions use the same schema as training

---

# Exploratory Data Analysis

## Delay Distribution

![](graphs/delay_distribution.png)

- Most flights are on time (0 min delay)
- Delays are right-skewed; a few flights experience significant delays

---

## Average Delay by Hour

![](graphs/avg_delay_by_hour.png)

- **Morning flights:** Minimal delays
- **Evening flights:** Delays spike after 17:00
- **Insight:** Booking earlier flights seems smarter

---

## Airline Performance

![](graphs/airline_ranking.png)

- **Ranking:** Airlines sorted by average delay
- **Key finding:** Some carriers (Air Incheon, UPS) have much higher delays
- **Actionable:** Choose airlines with lower average delays for fewer disruptions

---

## Temporal Delay Patterns

![](graphs/heatmap.png)

- **Heatmap:** Average delay by hour and day of week
- **Green:** On-time, **Red:** Severe delays
- **Patterns:** Evenings and certain days are riskier
- **Note:** Colors represent historical averages, not causality

---

## Wind Speed vs Delay

![](graphs/wind_vs_delay.png)

- **Hypothesis:** Higher wind = more delays?
- **Finding:** No strong correlation; delays do not consistently increase with wind
- **Lesson:** Simple factors are not enough—need multi-feature models

---

# Machine Learning Model

- **Model:** Random Forest Regression
- **Features:** Airline, departure/arrival airport, hour, day, wind speed
- **Target:** Departure delay (minutes)
- **Validation:** Trained/tested on historical data
- **Deployment:** Model predicts delays for new flights in real time

---

# Interactive Dashboard

- **Built with:** R Shiny + Plotly
- **Features:**
  - **Live Metrics:** Updates with filters and new data
  - **System Refresh:** Fetches latest flights and weather
  - **Flight Table:** Search, filter, and see ML-predicted delays
  - **Visualizations:** All insights available interactively

---

## Live Demo

- **Showcase:** Filtering by airline, hour, and seeing metrics update
- **System Refresh:** Demonstrate real-time data update
- **Flight Table:** Show predicted delays for upcoming flights

---

# Technical Highlights

- **Data pipeline automation:** Python + R integration
- **Reactive dashboard:** Shiny’s reactivity for instant feedback
- **Professional polish:** Clean UI, custom color scales, clear legends
- **Error handling:** Robust to missing/insufficient data

---

# Lessons Learned

- **Real data is messy:** Cleaning and validation are critical
- **Not all features matter:** Wind was a weak predictor
- **ML adds value:** Combining features yields better predictions
- **Automation saves time:** System refresh and data sync are essential

---

# Conclusion

- **Airport Traffic Analyzer** delivers actionable insights from real data
- **Professional workflow:** From data purchase to live dashboard
- **Ready for real-world use:** Predicts delays, guides decisions, and updates live
